evidence.title: Aligned Alone, Misaligned Together: Forecasting Adversarial Capture in LLM Agent Populations

summary: Research highlights how aligned AI agents can become misaligned when interacting in groups, posing risks of adversarial capture. The findings underscore challenges in ensuring cooperative behavior among autonomous LLM populations.
title: Study Warns of Adversarial Capture Risks in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
